name: Prince Waikiki
positioning: Independent Honolulu hotel on a harbor where every room and suite is ocean view or oceanfront, with an oceanfront infinity pool, a spa and its own golf course a drive away
best_for: Travelers who want ocean views from every room
Golfers who want a Honolulu base near the Hawaii Prince Golf Course
Conference guests at the Hawaii Convention Center

facts.text: Every room and suite at Prince Waikiki is ocean view or oceanfront.
The rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows.
The floor-to-ceiling windows open to let in the sea breeze.
Oceanfront Harbor rooms are on lower floors and overlook yachts and the Pacific Ocean.
Rooms and suites include TOTO washlets.
The hotel has three pools: an infinity pool for adults, a saltwater pool and a hot tub.
Private poolside cabanas and daybeds are available to rent.
The hotel shares art inspired by elements native to Oahu.
The on-site gym has treadmills, elliptical trainers, exercise bikes, strength machines and free weights.
Hinana Bar hosts SunSets LIVE poolside entertainment every Friday to Sunday.
Katsumidori Sushi Tokyo, at the hotel, has no other location outside Japan.
The hotel is minutes from the Hawaii Convention Center.

highlights.text: The infinity pool is oceanfront and sits over the harbor.
The Hawaii Prince Golf Course was designed by Arnold Palmer and Ed Seay and has three interchangeable nine-hole courses.
Naio Bliss is the hotel's spa, with treatments inspired by elements of the land and ocean, including coconut milk body wraps and hot stone massages.
The pool deck Club Lounge is reserved for guests in club-level rooms and offers breakfast, evening grazing and ocean views.
The Club Ocean Terrace Suite has indoor-outdoor living and Pacific Ocean views.

considerations.text: The hotel is on a harbor rather than on the beach.
The Hawaii Prince Golf Course is about a 40-minute drive from the hotel.
Bookings incur a daily resort charge unless otherwise noted.
